title: MBS plugin version
description: Plugin version requirement inventory: the minimum plugin version this solution needs, derived as the maximum since_version over all plug-in functions in use (verbatim per-function introduction versions from the MBS docs mirror via reference/plugin_spec.duckdb; numeric comparison via since_version_num, never lexicographic). Per-file spread and the driver functions make the derivation verifiable. The catalog knows no installed plugin version — pick one in the header select to validate against it: the neutral entry runs no check; choosing a version flags every call to a function introduced later (installed fleets are often heterogeneous, so divergent per-workstation versions can be validated one by one). Resolution is plugin-agnostic over plugref.plugins.
author: fm-lab

rule.rationale: The required plugin version is a derivation — the maximum documented introduction version (since_version) over the plug-in functions the solution actually calls. It is a deployment requirement, not a defect.
rule.remediation: Roll the plugin out at or above the required version on every workstation and server that executes the affected scripts. The drivers table shows which functions carry the requirement — replacing a driver can lower it.

defaultResult.name: plugin_version_required
defaultResult.meaning: Minimum plugin version this scope requires — maximum documented introduction version over the plug-in functions in use

params.name: file
params.description: Optional file filter (from the app-level filter).

params.name: installed_version
params.description: Installed plugin version to validate against (major.minor, from the header select). Empty = no check: the dashboard stays a neutral inventory.
